items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XIV, List of Answers on Topics 58:1
items.html: (To the question) It is known that the Mazal VeNakeh is the aspect of the Yesod, namely, the aspect of the male; however, in order to raise the returning light, it needs to be included also in the aspect of Benjamin, as the Rav said about the Yesod of ZA, that it is included of male and female, in the secret of "the living one of the worlds," see there. (Item 50).
